stem.text: An object of mass $m$ is suspended by a spring from a fixed point.

stem.alt: Spring hanging from a fixed support, with a box-shaped object attached to its lower end. Labels: spring; object of mass m.

stem.text: The spring has spring constant $k$. The object is set into vertical oscillations of period $T$.
Which equation for $T$ is homogeneous with respect to base units?
